msg: There's a good chance it might be random, and I don't know if I did well or not bcos I don't know the maximum you can get. I noticed pink and brown gnomes both give a red basket with the same background, and purple/green give orange basket with different background to pink/brown. I thought pink and brown (red basket) was more successful but this didn't hold up over time - pattern might swap midway through? Try to figure out early on whether the basket colour makes a difference to no. of mushrooms. I also thought reaction time might make a difference to mushroom number. Also the number of times you pick the same gnome, or which side the gnome is on? Not sure what makes the difference - or if anything does!! but it's worth considering all these things - my game might be different from yours so different combinations might mean something else for you.Also I'm pretty sure they said at the beginning you were rewarded for doing well in the game - but then they said we are rewarded for giving good advice so there's a good chance the game is irrelevant and this is the test.
